# commutai.com

> commutai.com is a premium .com domain name that is for sale. It joins "commute" and "AI" into one short, brandable word. The owner is accepting offers at https://commutai.com/#offer.

## Key facts

- Domain: commutai.com
- Status: for sale, open to offers (no fixed price)
- Length: 8 letters, 3 syllables, no hyphens or numbers
- Meaning: commute + AI, read as "commute-AI" or as the name "commu-tai"
- Registrar: Cloudflare
- How to buy: send an offer through the form at https://commutai.com/#offer; the owner replies by email
- Transfer: terms agreed in writing, payment through an escrow service such as Escrow.com, domain moved to the buyer's registrar with an authorization code, funds released after the buyer confirms ownership

## Good fits

- AI commute or travel companion app
- Smart transit and multi-modal journey planning
- Driver and in-car voice assistants
- Corporate commuting and mobility benefits
- Fleet, ride-share and EV routing
- Accessible, step-free travel guidance
